body:
# Work and the office

You already know 上班, 加班 and 老板. This lesson covers the rest of working life: projects and deadlines, who reports to whom, hiring and quitting, and how pay and performance are discussed. Several of these words (汇报, 请示, 领导) reflect how mainland offices are run.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 会议 | huìyì | meeting (formal noun) |
| 项目 | xiàngmù | project (at work) |
| 截止日期 | jiézhǐ rìqī | deadline |
| 负责 | fùzé | to be in charge of / responsible for |
| 汇报 | huìbào | to report (to a superior, on progress) |
| 升职 | shēngzhí | to get promoted |
| 辞职 | cízhí | to resign / quit (a job) |
| 面试 | miànshì | job interview / to interview |
| 简历 | jiǎnlì | résumé / CV |
| 客户 | kèhù | client (business customer) |
| 合作 | hézuò | to cooperate / work together (between people or companies) |
| 部门 | bùmén | department (in a company) |
| 经理 | jīnglǐ | manager (job title) |
| 领导 | lǐngdǎo | the higher-ups / one's superior (mainland workplace word) |
| 招聘 | zhāopìn | to recruit / hire (staff) |
| 培训 | péixùn | training (for staff) / to train |
| 绩效 | jìxiào | job performance (as evaluated) |
| 跳槽 | tiàocáo | to switch jobs (to another company) |
| 请示 | qǐngshì | to ask a superior for instructions / approval |
| 同行 | tóngháng | someone in the same industry / line of work |
| 效率 | xiàolǜ | efficiency |
| 进度 | jìndù | progress (against a schedule) |
| 待遇 | dàiyù | pay and benefits (the whole package) |
| 合同 | hétong | contract |
| 处理 | chǔlǐ | to handle / deal with (a problem, a task) |
| 年终奖 | niánzhōngjiǎng | year-end bonus |
| 跟进 | gēnjìn | to follow up (on a client, a matter) |

## Which word?

- **处理 vs 解决.** 处理 is dealing with something: you take it on. 解决 means it is actually solved. 问题处理了 says someone dealt with it; 问题解决了 says it's gone.
- **汇报 vs 报告 vs 请示.** 汇报 is reporting progress up the chain. 报告 is usually a written report. 请示 is asking a superior for a decision before you act.
- **经理 vs 领导 vs 老板.** 经理 is a job title. 领导 is anyone above you and is the normal mainland office word. 老板 is the owner or the boss in casual talk.
- **辞职 vs 跳槽.** 辞职 is quitting. 跳槽 is moving to another employer, usually for better pay.
- **客户 vs 顾客.** A firm has 客户; a shop or restaurant has 顾客.

## Examples

- 这个项目是谁负责的? zhège xiàngmù shì shéi fùzé de: Who's in charge of this project?
- 截止日期快到了,我们得赶进度。 jiézhǐ rìqī kuài dào le, wǒmen děi gǎn jìndù: The deadline is close, we need to catch up
- 我下周要去面试,简历还没改好。 wǒ xià zhōu yào qù miànshì, jiǎnlì hái méi gǎi hǎo: I have an interview next week and haven't finished my résumé
- 他辞职以后去了一家同行公司。 tā cízhí yǐhòu qù le yì jiā tóngháng gōngsī: After quitting he joined a company in the same industry
- 开完会我再跟你汇报。 kāi wán huì wǒ zài gēn nǐ huìbào: I'll report back to you after the meeting
- 跟这个客户合作了五年了。 gēn zhège kèhù hézuò le wǔ nián le: We've worked with this client for five years
- 绩效不好,年终奖就少了。 jìxiào bù hǎo, niánzhōngjiǎng jiù shǎo le: Poor performance means a smaller year-end bonus
- 这种事不用请示领导,你自己处理就行。 zhè zhǒng shì búyòng qǐngshì lǐngdǎo, nǐ zìjǐ chǔlǐ jiù xíng: No need to ask the boss, just handle it yourself
- 我们部门效率太低了。 wǒmen bùmén xiàolǜ tài dī le: Our department is far too inefficient

cards.Example: 下午三点有个会议。 xiàwǔ sān diǎn yǒu ge huìyì: There's a meeting at three this afternoon
cards.Notes: 开会 is the everyday verb 'have a meeting'; 会议 is the noun, more formal: 参加会议, 会议室.

cards.Example: 这个项目下个月要交。 zhège xiàngmù xià ge yuè yào jiāo: This project is due next month
cards.Notes: Also 'item' or 'event' in a list: 比赛项目 = sporting events.

cards.Example: 截止日期是这周五。 jiézhǐ rìqī shì zhè zhōuwǔ: The deadline is this Friday
cards.Notes: Spoken often just 截止 / 最晚: 周五截止.

cards.English: to be in charge of / responsible for
cards.Example: 这个项目由小王负责。 zhège xiàngmù yóu Xiǎo Wáng fùzé: Xiao Wang is in charge of this project
cards.Notes: 负责人 = person in charge. 对…负责 = be accountable for.

cards.English: to report (to a superior, on progress)
cards.Example: 我得跟领导汇报一下进度。 wǒ děi gēn lǐngdǎo huìbào yíxià jìndù: I need to report on progress to my boss
cards.Notes: 汇报 goes upward, to superiors; 报告 is a written report or a formal announcement.

cards.Example: 恭喜你升职了! gōngxǐ nǐ shēngzhí le: Congratulations on your promotion!
cards.Notes: 升职加薪 = promotion and a raise, a common pair.

cards.Example: 她上个月辞职了。 tā shàng ge yuè cízhí le: She quit last month
cards.Notes: 辞职 = you quit; 被辞退 / 被开除 = you got fired.

cards.Example: 我明天上午有个面试。 wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ yǒu ge miànshì: I have a job interview tomorrow morning
你把简历发给我看看。 nǐ bǎ jiǎnlì fā gěi wǒ kànkan: Send me your résumé and I'll take a look
客户对这个方案不太满意。 kèhù duì zhège fāng'àn bú tài mǎnyì: The client isn't very happy with this proposal
cards.Notes: 客户 = business client; 顾客 = shop customer.

cards.English: to cooperate / work together (between people or companies)
cards.Example: 希望以后有机会多合作。 xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì duō hézuò: Hope we get to work together more in future
cards.Notes: 合作愉快! = 'Here's to a good partnership!'

cards.Example: 你在哪个部门? nǐ zài nǎge bùmén: Which department are you in?
我们经理今天出差了。 wǒmen jīnglǐ jīntiān chūchāi le: Our manager is on a business trip today
cards.Notes: 经理 is a title; 领导 is anyone above you.

cards.English: the higher-ups / one's superior (mainland workplace word)
cards.Example: 这事得问问领导。 zhè shì děi wènwen lǐngdǎo: We'll have to ask the higher-ups about this
cards.Notes: Mainland offices say 领导 more than 老板 for one's superior.

cards.Example: 我们部门最近在招聘。 wǒmen bùmén zuìjìn zài zhāopìn: Our department is hiring right now
cards.Notes: 招人 is the casual spoken version.

cards.Example: 新员工要先培训一周。 xīn yuángōng yào xiān péixùn yì zhōu: New employees train for a week first
cards.Notes: 培训 = job training; 训练 = athletic or military drills.

cards.Example: 年底要做绩效考核。 niándǐ yào zuò jìxiào kǎohé: There's a performance review at year end
cards.Notes: 绩效考核 = performance review; 绩效奖金 = performance bonus.

cards.Example: 他又跳槽了,工资涨了不少。 tā yòu tiàocáo le, gōngzī zhǎng le bù shǎo: He switched jobs again and got a big pay rise
cards.Notes: Informal but universal.

cards.English: to ask a superior for instructions / approval
cards.Example: 这件事我得先请示一下经理。 zhè jiàn shì wǒ děi xiān qǐngshì yíxià jīnglǐ: I need to check with my manager first
cards.Notes: Formal office word; goes upward, like 汇报.

cards.English: someone in the same industry / line of work
cards.Example: 他是我同行,也做设计。 tā shì wǒ tóngháng, yě zuò shèjì: He's in my line of work, he's a designer too
cards.Notes: Read tóngháng here; tóngxíng means 'travel together'.

cards.Example: 这样做效率太低了。 zhèyàng zuò xiàolǜ tài dī le: Doing it this way is too inefficient
cards.Notes: 效率高 / 效率低 = efficient / inefficient.

cards.Example: 项目进度怎么样了? xiàngmù jìndù zěnmeyàng le: How's the project coming along?
cards.Notes: 赶进度 = rush to catch up on schedule. 进步 is personal improvement.

cards.Example: 那家公司待遇不错。 nà jiā gōngsī dàiyù búcuò: That company pays well and has good benefits
cards.Notes: 待遇 = the whole package; 工资 = salary only.

cards.Example: 签合同之前一定要看清楚。 qiān hétong zhīqián yídìng yào kàn qīngchu: Read it carefully before you sign the contract
cards.Notes: 签合同 = sign a contract; 续签 = renew.

cards.English: to handle / deal with (a problem, a task)
cards.Example: 这件事我来处理。 zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái chǔlǐ: I'll handle this
cards.Notes: 处理 = deal with it; 解决 = actually solve it.

cards.Example: 今年的年终奖发了吗? jīnnián de niánzhōngjiǎng fā le ma: Has this year's bonus been paid out?

cards.English: to follow up (on a client, a matter)
cards.Example: 这个客户你继续跟进一下。 zhège kèhù nǐ jìxù gēnjìn yíxià: Keep following up with this client

cards.English: Let me check and get back to you.
cards.Pinyin: wǒ quèrèn yíxià zài huífù nǐ
cards.Notes: 回复 = reply (messages, email); 答复 is a formal official reply.

cards.English: I've got too much on my plate right now, let's talk later.
cards.Hanzi: 我现在手上事情太多,晚点再说吧。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ xiànzài shǒushang shìqing tài duō, wǎndiǎn zài shuō ba
cards.Notes: 手上 / 手头 = what you're currently handling.
